authority.user_instruction: Prepare, verify, publish, and independently audit IncidentSeal v0.1.0 as a portable local-first release without changing the product promise, manifest authority, Docker trust boundary, evidence semantics, or explicit human gates.

scope.objective: Freeze, build, evaluate, publish, download, and independently verify a polished v0.1.0 GitHub and GHCR release from checkpoint-is-0005.
forbidden_work: Changing the approved product promise, manifest authority, Docker trust boundary, stable machine CLI semantics, or evidence-state distinctions
Giving any container a Docker socket or API socket, secret, privileged mode, host network, broad host mount, or external runtime network by default
Publishing or mirroring any image while redistribution remains INCONCLUSIVE or required notices and NOASSERTION entries are unresolved
Using mutable image tags as authority or publishing an image that is not source-gated, digest-pinned, scanned, SBOM-bound, provenance-bound, and runtime-verified
Using an unpinned GitHub Action, build backend, scanner, attestation tool, or release dependency
Adding PyPI, a paid service, user-managed secret, external credential, cloud platform, Kubernetes, multi-tenancy, or arbitrary remote execution
Enabling immutable releases, changing repository or package access, or taking another irreversible action without the exact human gate
Publishing a tag, image, asset, or release before its candidate gates pass
Claiming release completion from tests, source inspection, local tags, mutable tags, registry upload, or draft metadata alone
Shipping an artifact, image, release note, or public claim that cannot be independently downloaded and verified
reversible_actions: Freeze version, package, artifact, image, action, attestation, scan, reproducibility, and release-verification contracts
Add source-gated and digest-pinned packaging, build, scan, SBOM, provenance, and release dependencies
Build deterministic wheel and source-distribution candidates and verify them in fresh isolated environments
Build exact local OCI image candidates from pinned sources and verify all real topology, database, runner, dashboard, receipt, and recovery surfaces
Create digest-pinned GitHub workflow candidates that use only repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN authority
Create clean-clone and downloaded-artifact evaluators, release notes, checksums, notices, SBOMs, provenance, scan reports, and receipts
Commit and push verified bounded improvements
stop_conditions: A required change would alter the product promise, trust boundary, workflow approval authority, stable machine contract, or weaken an explicit security or evidence gate
An image or dependency cannot pass source, integrity, license, vulnerability, compatibility, and redistribution gates appropriate to its use
A build or release path requires a paid service, user-managed secret, real sensitive data, access or ownership change, or broader credential authority
Immutable-release enablement or another irreversible publication step is ready without exact owner confirmation
A candidate cannot reproduce from clean public custody or a published artifact cannot be independently downloaded and verified
A public claim would exceed the exact retained evidence

units.purpose: Freeze the v0.1.0 package, release-channel, image-redistribution, supply-chain, publication, and downloaded-verification contract before building an artifact.
inputs: Current official release and supply-chain practices
Current GitHub, Docker, Compose, packaging, and tool state
outputs: Pinned dependency and action source gates
retained_failures: IS-0006 opening keeps separate INVALID and INCONCLUSIVE discovery attempts in records/evaluations/IS-0006-milestone-opening-attempts.json.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The milestone is open from exact IS-0005 public custody; no release contract has yet passed.

units.purpose: Build reproducible dependency-free v0.1.0 wheel and source-distribution candidates and verify the installed CLI and dashboard in fresh isolated environments.
Resolve exact image redistribution obligations, build deterministic OCI candidates, and retain notices, SBOM, provenance, scan, hardening, and reproducibility evidence.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: U02 must pass first and publication remains forbidden while redistribution is INCONCLUSIVE.

units.purpose: Verify the complete candidate from clean installation and clean public clone across the real CLI, Compose, PostgreSQL, runners, dashboard, receipts, recovery, and release-artifact surfaces.
After every candidate gate passes, publish exact GHCR digests and a complete v0.1.0 GitHub Release draft, then publish the immutable release only after its exact irreversible-action gate.
inputs: Exact owner confirmation for irreversible release immutability and publication

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The user authorized release work but explicitly reserved irreversible actions; exact confirmation is deferred until the fully verified publication set is ready.

units.purpose: Independently pull exact public image digests, download every release asset, verify attestations and immutability, replay the real release surface, reconcile public records, and mark the release checkpoint.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Public artifacts do not exist yet.

required_checks: Source-gated and digest-pinned build backends, scanners, SBOM/provenance tools, and GitHub Actions
Reproducible wheel and source distribution with isolated installation and exact CLI JSON/JSONL plus exit-code behavior
Complete license and notice reconciliation with no unresolved NOASSERTION before image publication
Exact-digest OCI images with SPDX SBOM, SLSA provenance, current vulnerability scans, runtime hardening, and repeated-build evidence
No Docker socket, secret, privileged mode, host network, broad host mount, or external runtime network by default
Real packaged and clean-clone CLI, Compose, PostgreSQL, Python, Node, dashboard, receipt, recovery, and teardown verification
Distinct PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, INVALID, cancelled, failed, stale, and superseded evidence throughout
Public tag, commit, release assets, checksums, attestations, exact registry digests, immutability, download, pull, and clean-consumer verification
completed_checks: Verified checkpoint-is-0005 entry, public repository and remote main, absent GitHub release, missing workflow approval, no IncidentSeal containers or networks, and exact protected-volume custody
Recorded package-registry visibility as INCONCLUSIVE because the current GitHub token lacks read:packages instead of claiming absence
Recorded GitHub release immutability as disabled and reserved any change for the irreversible-action human gate
Confirmed the checkout has no package metadata or GitHub workflows and that Buildx is present while dedicated signing, SBOM, and scanner CLIs are absent

do_not_carry_forward: Do not alter or automate operator approval or execute repository workflow input
Do not weaken Docker, manifest-authority, evidence-state, or release-evidence gates
Do not publish an image while redistribution is INCONCLUSIVE
Do not add PyPI, paid services, or user-managed secrets to v0.1.0
Do not enable immutable releases or publish an irreversible release without the exact human gate
Do not claim package, registry, downloaded release, or v0.1.0 completion before every real surface passes
